$comment: Figma Code Connect registry. scripts/generate-code-connect.mjs reads it and writes src/app/components/<module>.figma.ts (v2 parserless templates; a second template of the same module is named after its export). scripts/check-code-connect.mjs gates the result (pnpm figma:connect:check, and pnpm test).

templates.<Export>.properties records the Figma component property definitions: name, type, options, default. They are the ones in figma/reads/component-properties.json (the live read): the gate fails on any difference. It also records how each property maps onto the code prop. The code side (props, cva keys, defaultVariants) is always read from source, never copied here.

Node URLs are not stored here. They come from the component JSDoc tag `@figma <node-url>` through public/hds-manifest.json figmaUrl, or, for a compound part with no tag (TabsTrigger, NavListItem, TimelineItem), from figma/mapping-overrides.json: run pnpm manifest:generate && pnpm figma:connect:generate after changing one. A template without a URL is generated with a placeholder and reported as unmapped.
TEXT defaults are the Figma defaults and are preview text for the local renderer. INSTANCE_SWAP has no default here: the renderer shows <IconInstance />.
codeOnly on a VARIANT mapped with prop lists cva keys that have no Figma option yet, each with a reason. Any other unmapped cva key fails pnpm figma:connect:check.

children is raw JSX for the element's children; {{Figma name}} inserts a TEXT property, or the mapped value of a VARIANT that has no prop / set. A BOOLEAN with set maps true and false onto props. importFrom names the component's module when it is not the top-level importFrom; imports lists the extra names a snippet uses, by module. figmaOnly records a property that has no prop, with the reason.
exempt lists every public cva module (a src/index.ts barrel export whose file calls cva()) that has no template, with the reason.

evidence.read-2026-11-15: Component property definitions read from the live library (2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ) on 2026-11-15 with the Figma MCP tool use_figma, recorded in figma/reads/component-properties.json (ledger 2026-11-15, C4 and C5). pnpm figma:connect:check fails when an entry differs from that read.

Body.default: Main alert message content goes here.

Badge.note: With Type=count or Type=dot the code ignores children; the snippet keeps the label so the three types read alike.

Button.note: Tone is a Figma VARIANT since 2026-11-16 (neutral on every variant; quiet, danger, success, warning, info at md/rest, each set to its Button tone collection mode). hoverEffect and shadow have no Figma property.

Focus.figmaOnly: Focus ring preview. Focus is a runtime state, not a prop.

Error message.figmaOnly: Shown only when State=Error. The grammar gates text on a BOOLEAN, so the Error option sets error alone; pass errorMessage with it.

Error message.figmaOnly: Shown only when State=Error; pass errorMessage with error.

Show action.figmaOnly: The action is a child the application supplies.

Filename.figmaOnly: Gated by the Show filename VARIANT; that option sets a sample filename.

Combobox.note: Selection=Creatable adds creatable and onCreate in code. They are one branch of a props union the code model does not read, so the snippet shows the single-select form.

src/app/components/field.tsx.reason: figma/code-connect-map.json pairs Field with node 85:81, which Figma names "FormField (form.tsx)": its properties (Label, Helper, State, Required) are FormField's, not Field's (read 2026-11-15). The pairing needs a decision before a template (hds#1557).

src/app/components/stat.tsx.reason: Stat is deprecated in code (no replacement planned) and its Figma component (88:247) is excluded from the Code Connect map as deprecated. No template: a snippet would recommend a deprecated component.

src/app/components/toast.tsx.reason: The Figma Toast (93:367) is one toast. Code has no Toast element: a toast is raised with useToast() under ToastProvider, so a JSX template of ToastProvider would be wrong for it. Needs a non-JSX example (hds#1557).

src/app/components/table.tsx.reason: The Figma Table (89:300) was read on 2026-11-15 (Density, Sortable, StickyHeader). A template opts Table into check-figma-mapping, which then fails: the cva density axis has an internal key, follow, that the density prop does not accept. Resolve the axis first (hds#1557).
